This creature resembles a four-armed jellyfish except that it hovers in the air. Electricity crackles within an exposed translucent dome on the upper part of its bell and along its hanging arms.

Thundercloud jellyfish are a docile species of floating creatures. They attack when provoked but otherwise float along eating vegetation by pulling it up to their floating bell with their dangling arms. Their bell pulls in radiant arcane and general static energy to build up electricity in their bodies primarily to allow them to float and for protection. Some cultures have taken to herding them and domesticating them as a form of cattle. Though their flesh is inedible, the tough leathery skin on the underside of the bell has similar uses to other leathers.

Additionally, the congealed jelly in their bell that stores the electric energy can be harvested. This jelly, called “thundercloud jelly” has a paralytic and analgesic agent that is helpful in various medicines. If distilled by an alchemist, it can be distilled further down into a poison that can paralyze. This is generally viewed as illegal due to the dangers it could pose. When harvested from a dead thundercloud jelly is not poisonous nor paralytic.

To create the poison, the alchemists use a process similar to the one employed naturally by the jellyfish as it changes it to a paralytic agent in its arms. The DC to craft the poison from thundercloud jelly is DC 16.
